:::{#exm-result}
#### A proposition that is a result, and one that is not

"$2 + 3 = 5$" is a proposition (@def-proposition) that has a proof,
the computation of $2 + 3$,
so it is a result.
"$7$ is [even](number-systems.qmd#def-even-odd)" is a proposition that is false,
so it has no proof and is not a result.

:::
